plainText:
If you were looking for a glitch Pokémon, see A (C0) or ▶ A.

 
"A" (Japanese: Aさん Ms. A) is a recurring character in the Pokémon Adventures . Her real name is unknown.

==History==
=== ===
A first appeared in Danger: High Voltorb. She was seen on a newspaper that was shown to by the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman. She had received a shock when taking a bath with her .

=== ===
In The Last Battle XIII, she was seen taking another bath with her Tentacool. A was one of the people who heard a message from the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman asking for people to send their Pokémon to help battle .

=== ===
In Epilogue, A and her Tentacool were among the many people who went to the as a result of Scott wishing on .

==Pokémon==
 

==Trivia==
In the English versions of Danger: High Voltorb by Chuang Yi and VIZ, there is a quote by A that was not found in the Japanese version: "That's the last bath I'll take with my !" This contradicts her later appearance in The Last Battle XIII, where she is seen bathing with her Tentacool again.
